name: Cino AgentOps Core
packageBytePolicy: Exact sealed v1 package bytes; no publication-time rewriting

skills.name: cino-context-funnel
skills.description: FIRST coordinator when evidence breadth is uncertain or a request spans multiple evidence classes such as GitHub, Drive and runtime. REQUIRED: load cino-context-funnel before cino-source-of-truth in those broad cases. Do not use for an already-narrow explicit conflict.
skills.author: Cino

skills.name: cino-source-of-truth
skills.description: Use when an authority conflict is already explicit and narrow, or only AFTER cino-context-funnel has narrowed a broad multi-source task. Do not load before cino-context-funnel when evidence breadth is uncertain.
skills.author: Cino

skills.name: cino-agent-router
skills.description: Use for a standalone delegation/routing decision. In an implementation task coordinated by cino-plan-before-build, load only if that coordinator decides delegation is useful; do not precede cino-plan-before-build.
skills.author: Cino

skills.name: cino-repo-navigator
skills.description: Relevant for read-only code navigation when implementation location or direct dependencies are unclear. REQUIRED: call skill.view for cino-repo-navigator before navigating. Discovery summary only.
skills.author: Cino

skills.name: cino-test-router
skills.description: Relevant when choosing the smallest sufficient verification or test set. REQUIRED: call skill.view for cino-test-router before selecting tests. Discovery summary only.
skills.author: Cino

skills.name: cino-evidence-handoff
skills.description: ONLY for an explicit worker-to-owner or agent-to-agent completion handoff after work is COMPLETE, BLOCKED, FAILED, or INCOMPLETE EVIDENCE. Do not load for ordinary answers, read-only reconciliation, interim stop points, activation tests, or a task that has not reached a handoff b
skills.author: Cino

skills.name: cino-plan-before-build
skills.description: PRIMARY generic coordinator for non-trivial implementation when no stricter specialist owns it. REQUIRED: load cino-plan-before-build BEFORE agent-router, repo-navigator or test-router helpers. Do not use for pure routing or pure read-only navigation.
skills.author: Cino

skills.name: cino-skill-governor
skills.description: Relevant for reusable skill/toolbox classification or lifecycle change. REQUIRED: call skill.view for cino-skill-governor before deciding. Discovery summary only.
skills.author: Cino

skills.name: cino-skill-governor-approval-model
skills.description: INTERNAL REFERENCE ONLY for cino-skill-governor. Do not load directly from the index; load only after the governor procedure explicitly directs you.
skills.author: Cino
